mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 31 degrees and clear at Reddan Soccer Park with a waxing crescent moon. Please note that the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

Verona city officials are preparing for the upcoming December 7th Plan Commission meeting where site plans for the Sub-Zero project in Liberty Business Park will be reviewed. Also, the Municipal Court is reminding residents that while many tickets can be paid online, mandatory appearances or O W I cases require direct communication with the court clerk.

We have a full slate of activities starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Paddy Mac's, followed by the music of John Denver at the High School Fine Arts Center this Saturday.

A noteworthy incident occurred on October 25th when officers were dispatched to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue. A 40-year-old man was taken into custody and arrested for his first offence O W I after being found unresponsive behind the wheel.
If you are craving something sweet, today's flavor is Raspberry Cheesecake. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:30 PM.
